text: The case status stays rwb-case's. rwb-treatment reports a stage outcome to the parent CaseWorkflow and the parent moves the status and raises the task; no case table is read or written by this service (DP-01).
why: Every acceptance criterion of RWB-E3-012 ends with the case in a new state (OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER_DIL, WITH_FIELD_INSPECTION, ASSET_ON_BOOKS), while Architecture v5 slide 41 gives the case and its CMMN state to rwb-case and DP-01 forbids reading another service's tables.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 41 (rwb-case owns case, CMMN state, queues, tasks, allocation, timers) and slide 18 (S2 rwb-treatment IN/OUT); Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 13 and 14 (CaseWorkflow is the parent, each stage is a child, the parent forwards the event to the running stage); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01
applied_in: RWB-S2-E3012-APP and RWB-S2-E3012-CON: section 3, section 4, section 7 Target reading, section 9 State transitions, section 12.4
confirm: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P3 owner of the case workflow at the wave 2 build start
impact: If the parent does not own the transition, a stage would have to signal rwb-case over REST and a C dependency would appear on the plan; no business rule changes either way.

text: The ACE customer and NPA-asset facts a deed in lieu needs arrive on the case signal as facts of rwb-source-data's read; rwb-treatment reads no v_ace_* view and calls no source-data service, because the connection matrix gives it no such link.
why: The legacy story reads v_ace_customer (DF-ACE-055 to DF-ACE-074) and v_ace_npa_asset (DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219) directly, while DP-05 sends ACE data through rwb-source-data's contract or the service's own views, slide 8 grants the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone, and slide 13 gives the S2 row no cell for P1.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 8 ('30 recovery.v_ace_* views (read only by rwb-source-data)'), slide 13 (S2 row: T and E to P3 and P7, E to S8, T to P5 and P8, N to ACE common, no cell for P1) and slide 41; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-05
applied_in: RWB-S2-E3012-APP: section 3, section 4, section 7 Target reading, section 11 Data, section 12.2, section 12.7, section 13; RWB-S2-E3012-CON: section 3, section 12.7
confirm: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P1 owner of the source-data contract and the P3 owner of the case signal at the wave 2 build start
impact: If a direct read is allowed instead, one contract read of rwb-source-data appears in the stage and a C dependency joins the plan; the elements, the rules and the criteria are unchanged.

text: The asset record, the AMIS interface, the debt settlement and the registration release are requested through rwb-asset and rwb-integration and return as facts on the workflow; this service calls no external system and the Work Package's empty external list stands.
why: R-DIL-28 requires the asset to be recorded in AMIS, the debt settled and the registration released, the legacy story calls AMIS, SCIS and ALS in process, TSD T5.1 names INT-03 core bank (ALS) but no AMIS and no SCIS interface, and the Work Package declares no external and no integration dependency.
read: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-27 ('Record the NPA in AMIS, settle the debt and release the collateral in CCMS') and R-DIL-28 ('Record the asset in AMIS, settle the debt and release the registration'); TSD S2 T5.1 (INT-03 Core bank (ALS), INT-26 NLEADS, INT-34 ACE common module); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8 and 13 (shared capabilities reached through Temporal, external systems through rwb-integration); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-16
applied_in: RWB-S2-E3012-APP: section 3, section 4, section 7 Target reading, section 12.2, section 12.5, section 12.8, section 13; RWB-S2-E3012-CON: section 3, section 12.7, section 19

text: The deed-in-lieu document set, its templates and the customer notice are rwb-document's and rwb-comms'; the stage requests them through the workflow kit on their queues, and the field inspection captures are documents of rwb-document.
why: R-DIL-16 requires the documents to be generated and the offer put to the customer, the legacy story writes document rows in the shared schema, the templates are FEAT-TRT-18's, and the Work Package declares no contract dependency for this story.
read: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-DIL-16 ('Generate the documents and put the offer to the customer'); FSD S2 A2.12.3.1 and A2.2.3.1; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8, 13 and 41 (rwb-document owns documents and Blob); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-11 and DP-19
applied_in: RWB-S2-E3012-APP: section 3, section 4, section 12.5, section 12.8, section 19; RWB-S2-E3012-CON: section 3, section 12.7, section 19
confirm: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P5 owner of the document hub at the wave 2 build start
impact: If the document set is built here, a contract dependency on rwb-document is added to the plan and the stage grows a template module; the criteria and the rules do not change.

text: The embedded Drools runtime, the DEEDINLIEU rule package and the ApprovalWorkflow child of the workflow kit are the service template's wave-0 capability; this story names the evaluated package and its version and adds no build dependency of its own beyond the three the Work Package lists.
why: Every criterion ends with the result written with its rule version, Architecture v5 slide 18 runs DIL 37 rules in rwb-treatment, and the Work Package's patterns are DP03, DP05, DP13 and DP19 with no Drools or workflow-kit contract among its H dependencies.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 18 ('rwb-treatment - RES 37 - SET 27 - DIL 37') and slide 18 ('TMP Decision: child: approval'); Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 13 and 15 (rules evaluate in the owning service, inside an activity); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04 and DP-10
applied_in: RWB-S2-E3012-APP: section 3, section 7 Target reading, section 8, section 12.4, section 12.5, section 13; RWB-S2-E3012-CON: section 4, section 12.4

impact: If the runtime is not template-provided, RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and RWB-P7-E1073-CON become build and contract dependencies of the stage; only the dependency list changes, not the rules or the criteria.

text: The deed-in-lieu facts are held on the treatment row as transferPrice, inspectionOutcome, unlockDecision, assetRef and transferredAt, with the transfer price carried as offerAmount (DF-TRT-007) in the representation; no table is created for the inspection or the transfer and no event announces the transfer completion.
why: The TSD stops at DF-TRT-033 with no such field, the API Specification publishes no treatment element for them, and the catalogue gives the service one event; a table of its own for either step would let the same asset be recorded twice, once as a row and once as a record, which DP-03 and Principle 5 forbid.
